name: Personal Meeting Notes (tight, complete action list)

sections.title: What this was
sections.purpose: Two or three sentences: whose meeting it was, who was in it, and what it covered. Nothing else.

sections.title: Decided
sections.purpose: Decisions that were actually made. One sentence each, carrying the number, date or name that makes the decision real.

sections.title: Still open
sections.purpose: Things raised and left unsettled. One sentence each, ending with who or what it now waits on, in brackets.

sections.title: Actions
sections.purpose: One line per action, written exactly as: **Owner** - what they will do - *when*. EVERY action the recording leaves with someone appears here, including the ones owed to the recorder by other people. Use the name the recording used; write **Me** for the person who recorded this. Put the timing only if it was spoken, otherwise write *no date*. Never invent an owner or a date. One line per distinct piece of work -- if two people share one job, that is still one line naming both.

catch_all.title: Anything else
catch_all.purpose: Only what will still matter next week and fits nowhere above. One sentence each. If there is nothing, write "Nothing here."

style: Keep the prose sections under roughly 350 words in total. They are read on a phone, standing up.
One sentence per item. If an item needs two, the second is usually the part nobody will act on -- cut it.
The Actions list is the exception: it is complete, however long that makes it.
Never say the same thing twice, in one section or across two.
Keep every figure, date and company name that was actually spoken; those are the parts a reader cannot reconstruct.
